title: Samrey: A Fine-Grained Reactive Framework Architecture with Zero-Virtual-DOM Execution, Native Defense-in-Depth, and Integrated Developer Guidance
description: Research paper artifact and reproducibility bundle for the Samrey Framework (v1.0.0). Samrey is an enterprise-grade TypeScript web application framework built on fine-grained push-pull reactivity, zero-VDOM template cloning, defense-in-depth security, and an integrated developer guidance ecosystem.
